name: The blessed life of delighting in God's law
place: a wisdom psalm on the two ways
summary: The psalm opens by describing the person who avoids the counsel of the wicked and instead delights in God's law.

name: The contrasting fates of the righteous and the wicked
place: a wisdom psalm on the two ways
summary: The righteous are compared to a fruitful tree by streams of water while the wicked are compared to chaff the wind blows away.

name: Humanity crowned with glory and honor over creation
place: a creation hymn of praise
summary: David marvels that God gave humanity dominion and honor over the rest of the created world.

name: The heavens declaring God's glory and the perfection of his law
place: a psalm on creation and God's law
summary: David moves from the silent testimony of the skies to praise for the perfect, trustworthy law of the Lord.

name: David's cry of abandonment surrounded by enemies
place: a lament psalm of the suffering righteous one
summary: David describes feeling forsaken by God while mockers and enemies close in around him.

name: David's turn from despair to praise among the nations
place: a lament psalm of the suffering righteous one
summary: The psalm shifts from anguish to confident praise, anticipating that all the families of the nations will worship God.

name: The Lord as shepherd and provider
place: a psalm of pastoral trust
summary: David declares the Lord his shepherd who provides rest, water, and guidance along right paths.

name: God's presence through the darkest valley
place: a psalm of pastoral trust
summary: David affirms God's presence and comfort even through the valley of the shadow of death, and pictures a hospitable feast in his enemies' sight.

name: The King of glory entering his gates
place: a royal psalm for temple entry
summary: David calls for the gates to lift up so the King of glory can enter in triumphant procession.

name: The relief of confessed and forgiven sin
place: a wisdom psalm on forgiven sin
summary: David contrasts the misery of hiding his sin with the relief that came once he confessed it to God.

name: God as refuge amid earth's upheaval
place: a psalm of refuge in Zion
summary: The sons of Korah declare God a secure refuge even if the earth gives way and the mountains fall into the sea.

name: David's confession of his sin with Bathsheba
place: written after Nathan confronted David over Bathsheba
summary: David confesses his sin and pleads for God's mercy after Nathan the prophet confronted him.

name: David's plea for a clean heart and restored joy
place: written after Nathan confronted David over Bathsheba
summary: David asks God to create a clean heart in him, restore his joy, and lets him teach other sinners God's ways.

name: God's eternity against humanity's fleeting years
place: a meditation on human frailty and God's eternity
summary: Moses contrasts God's everlasting existence with the brief, trouble-filled span of a human life.

name: Moses' prayer to number our days wisely
place: a meditation on human frailty and God's eternity
summary: Moses prays that God would teach his people to number their days and establish the work of their hands.

name: The safety of dwelling in God's shelter
place: a psalm of divine protection
summary: The psalmist describes the safety of the one who dwells in the shelter of the Most High, covered from danger.

name: A call to enter God's gates with thanksgiving
place: a psalm of thanksgiving for worship
summary: The psalmist calls all the earth to worship the Lord with joyful songs and thanksgiving.

name: David's roll call of God's benefits
place: a psalm of praise for God's mercy
summary: David calls himself to remember God's forgiveness, healing, and steady love toward him.

name: The Lord's unsleeping watch over his people
place: a psalm of ascent for pilgrims
summary: The psalmist answers his own question about where help comes from with the Lord, who watches over his people without slumbering.

name: A cry for mercy from the depths
place: a penitential psalm of ascent
summary: The psalmist cries out to God from deep distress over sin and waits for him the way a watchman waits for morning.

name: God's intimate knowledge of David's every thought
place: a meditation on God's omniscience
summary: David reflects on how thoroughly God knows his thoughts, words, and actions before he acts on them.

name: David's invitation for God to search his heart
place: a meditation on God's omniscience
summary: David closes by inviting God to search his heart and lead him away from sin toward the way everlasting.

name: David's praise of God's greatness across generations
place: an acrostic psalm of praise
summary: David praises God's greatness and goodness, celebrating that the Lord is gracious and near to all who call on him.

name: A call to praise God with every instrument
place: a closing psalm of pure praise
summary: The psalmist lists instruments from trumpet to cymbals as fitting ways to praise God.

name: Everything that breathes praising the Lord
place: a closing psalm of pure praise
summary: The psalm and the whole Psalter close with a call for everything that has breath to praise the Lord.
